name: Chichiizumi Touka
source:
Actual Breast Priestess. Grandmother of Ukyou. Mother of Renka and Momoka.

In Chichi Miko!!:
She is still young, but she wants to give the job to a younger girl.

Chichi Miko!! Plus 1:
She married Ukyou and had a daughter with him. The three of them live together in the shrine.
